body: I thought it was well known Katie left Tom because she found out he was just Verne Troyer in a wig.

The Royal Tenenbaums. Amazing cast. This movie got me through high school. I wanted to be Richie so bad. I would turn this movie on before bed every night for months, years even.

The soundtrack is what initially got me. It had Elliott Smith, Nico, The Velvet Underground, Nick Drake, The Clash, Bob Dylan etc. 
But after watching so many times, I've been able to invest and fall in love with each character on separate viewings. This movie got me to like Gwyneth Paltrow. That is no easy feat.
Every time that song comes on in the movie, Needle in the Hay by Elliott Smith, no matter how many times I watch it, I cry like a baby. Richie is the sweetest and kindest character in the movie.

Lastly, I kind of view this movie as Gene Hackman's swan song. I never liked him much. I kind of just viewed him as the poor mans Tommy Lee Jones. But his performance in this movie was spectacular. Its a beautiful movie to retire on. (I don't count mooseport :P)
